attempts.summary: Repaired and deployed the UDP meter collector on node1. Valid node2 datagrams are durably appended, duplicate meter/sequence pairs are ignored across service and host restarts, malformed payloads are logged separately, and the original west,1,42 reading remains intact. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification on unchanged RHEL 10/kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.
